purpose: Owner-authorized portable 0.11.0 release preflight. This record does not itself claim publication succeeded.

authorization.ownerInstruction: We also need to release a new version if new functionality has landed.
authorization.scope: Release the already-prepared portable 0.11.0 functionality through the existing main-ref OIDC workflow, then verify npm/GitHub/installed consumers.
exclusions: Source-only hosted modules are not portable package exports
authorization.standingInstruction: Remember we need to merge PRs that are green and pass all the testing to main, yeah? And then at reasonable milestones we should release package versions.
authorization.standingScope: Reviewed green merges followed by coherent portable 0.x milestone releases through the existing verified process. Not every PR, documentation correction or private hosted slice requires a package bump. Explicit 1.0.0 and hosted-deployment owner gates remain.

findings.issue: Changelog could imply all release/registry verification already completed.
findings.resolution: Call it the authorized portable release candidate and explicitly date verification/publication as pending at the preparation step.

findings.issue: README could imply 0.11.0 was already available through npm latest.
findings.resolution: Use dated pre-publication source-candidate snapshots in both locations, with the observed 0.10.0 registry baseline and live badge for current availability. This remains historically accurate inside an immutable npm archive after publication.
